correctness.rationale: Preservation of J follows because all of J consists of nilpotent elements and an element with nonzero scalar part is a unit. Arbitrary generator images in J extend uniquely. For fixed commuting tangent idempotents, on a component V_a to W_b of Hom(V,J²), idempotence forces Q_i=0 if a_i=b_i (the multiplier a_i+b_i−1 is ±1); commutativity says (a_j−b_j)Q_i=(a_i−b_i)Q_j. If a≠b this gives exactly one free C block via Q_i=(a_i−b_i)C; if a=b all Q_i vanish. This works also in characteristic two, proves the exponent by summing the nonresonant blocks, and is precisely conjugation by v↦v+C(v), which fixes J² and has inverse v↦v−C(v). The tensor action has weights given by AND and the tangent orbit of labelled decompositions has the claimed block-diagonal stabilizer even with empty eigenspaces. Simultaneous conjugacy and the weak-composition class count follow. A commuting product fixes exactly the common image, and in the linear model its image in A has the free truncated basis on a tangent space of dimension r_S, including r_S=0 and the empty product. For d=k=2 there are four one-label profiles, five comparable two-label pairs with exponent 4 and one incomparable pair with exponent 6, giving the stated polynomial. An independent direct bit-packed substitution check over F₂ tested all 4096 generator assignments, recovered 98 idempotents and 868 commuting pairs in ten profiles, and checked product images on J; see /workspace/branches/independent_replays/replay1.py and replay1.out. This small replay does not establish arbitrary characteristic, which follows from the proof.
